verdict.rationale: Linear's 'Loops' feature explicitly lets users describe a job in plain language and set it to run on a schedule or in response to an event, enabling autonomous background automation (e.g., updating docs, drafting updates, triaging issues) — docs-11, docs-36, docs-34, docs-45 all corroborate this recurring/autonomous behavior. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Loops reliability in production and more detail on failure handling or monitoring of autonomous runs.
